source_selection: source_requests[:16], existing eligible ranks 832..847, unchanged source order, no output/quality/latency filtering
scope: Development summarization task from already-viewed articles. Not held-out confirmation. Original article text retained unchanged; no model outputs observed for annotation.
annotation_method: Assistant source-only manual propositions, ordered by supporting passage. Exactly three distinct core facts per article; no generated output used. Claims paraphrase source rather than asserting externally updated facts.

rubric.coverage: One point per covered core proposition, accepting faithful paraphrases; a vague topic mention is not coverage. Do not require matching wording. Meaningful partial/ambiguous coverage is recorded explicitly for review, not automatically rounded upward.
rubric.useful: At least 2 of 3 core facts covered and no substantive unsupported or contradictory factual claim anywhere in the output.
rubric.support: Supporting spans are exact Python character offsets [start,end) in article_text, not byte offsets. Source text, including WikiText punctuation tokens, is unmodified.
rubric.format: Record sentence count separately; format deviations alone do not turn a supported fact into an error.
rubric.quality_gate_unchanged: 16 complete, zero empty, natural EOS at least14, periodic suffix at most1, useful summaries at least12; only a development screen, not quality equivalence.
rubric.known_limitation: Three selected facts are a small source-grounded rubric, not an exhaustive reference summary or automatic ROUGE gold. Additional accurate facts are allowed; all output claims require source support.
